scope: Read-only candidate/input byte equality, actual workspace artifact/public-contract coverage, full SKILL bytes, complete LLM/ACP JSONL parsing, usage/accounting and training distinction for canonical plan slots.

method.trajectory_gate: Equivalent manual deterministic parser: every line of canonical LLM, ACP, native events and trainer row parsed; nonempty real request/response and per-row usage audited.

global_limits: Scores and public-contract delivery coverage are separate findings.
Native recovered partial trajectories remain scoring-valid under the explicit user protocol, but training_ready=false remains non-SFT-ready.
Exact full-body evidence missing after Flink redaction is unknown, not silently verified.
Provider token splits and supplier invoice costs remain unknown when not returned.
Original last-slot verifier timeout has been recovered by official scoring only; all 21 slots now have valid grades.

Trainer compatibility fields encode total-only usage as input_tokens and output=0; these are not observed provider token splits. Last-slot verifier-error zero placeholder was replaced by a valid official zero score after scoring-only recovery.

limits: Existence and data-copy integrity do not independently prove browser interactions or visual quality; official tests are reported separately.
